title: Polynomial and power-series quotients by a distinguished polynomial
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, complete for its $\mathfrak m$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $P=T^n+\sum_{i<n}b_iT^i\in B[T]$, where $n\geq0$ and every $b_i\in\mathfrak m$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. The inclusion $B[T]\to B[[T]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] induces an isomorphism of $B$-algebras $B[T]/(P)\xrightarrow{\sim}B[[T]]/(P)$.
